title: External Parent-Material Authority Acquisition Adjudication

register_preflight.requested_scientific_state: Physically defensible parent-material / near-surface geological initial state for eventual pedogenesis initialization.

temporal_strategy: No paleo interpolation or extrapolation authorized in PRE1; candidate-specific adapters are required.

requirement_matrix.basis: Conditioning class; not equivalent to parent material.
Needed to distinguish transported/alluvial/colluvial material from bedrock.
Required for a defensible provenance/initial-state contract.
Needed if mineral-specific weathering or nutrient release is modeled.
Controls available near-surface material volume; remains distinct from lithology.
Boundary condition for any vertical profile.
Required by physical soil initialization, not supplied by GLiM or thickness-only data.
Useful for physical parameterization; not a parent-material identity field.
Required for a non-single-layer pedogenesis input.
Governance requires uncertainty propagation or explicit refusal.
Modern static products cannot silently become paleo trajectories.

candidates.coverage: Global land/surface representation; gridded product at 0.5 degree; original map uses polygons.
candidates.native_representation: polygon source plus gridded raster distribution
candidates.native_crs: Geographic global grid; dataset-specific metadata must be bound at acquisition.
candidates.license_access: PANGAEA access and citation required; rights/provenance are inherited from contributing geological agencies and must be checked at acquisition.
candidates.temporal_classification: STATIC_VALID_OVER_TARGET_INTERVAL only as a documented bedrock-lithology approximation; not a paleo surficial-deposit history.
candidates.arcana_remap: Categorical area-weighted or majority remap to ARCANA grid; land/water/ice masks must be explicit.

candidates.source: Pelletier et al. (2016), DOI 10.1002/2015MS000526; ORNL DAAC 1304, DOI 10.3334/ORNLDAAC/1304
candidates.coverage: Global approximately 30 arc-second (~1 km) grid, approximately -60 to 90 latitude; ocean/upland/lowland/lake/perennial-ice mask.
candidates.native_representation: gridded raster products by landform type
candidates.native_crs: Global geographic 30 arc-second grid; exact acquisition metadata required.
candidates.license_access: Public ORNL/NASA catalog entry; dataset download and citation/terms must be bound from ORNL at acquisition; article states the data are archived and obtainable through ORNL DAAC.
candidates.temporal_classification: PRESENT_DAY_ONLY / REQUIRES_TEMPORAL_ADAPTER; NASA catalog describes geological present, not a 200 ka trajectory.
candidates.arcana_remap: Continuous area-weighted/conservative remap for thickness; categorical mask by majority/area fraction; nodata and water/ice remain explicit.

candidates.source: Poggio et al. (2021), SoilGrids 2.0, DOI 10.5194/soil-7-217-2021; official ISRIC documentation.
candidates.coverage: Global SoilGrids250m maps at 250 m, six standard depth intervals 0-5, 5-15, 15-30, 30-60, 60-100, 100-200 cm; aggregated 1 km and 5 km products are available.
candidates.native_representation: raster GeoTIFF/VRT and OGC WCS; REST API is beta/operationally constrained.
candidates.native_crs: Global mapping services with documented WCS CRS negotiation; bind exact CRS at acquisition.
candidates.license_access: CC BY 4.0 for SoilGrids predictions; WCS/WebDAV/portal access; full global maps are large and were not downloaded.
candidates.temporal_classification: PRESENT_DAY_ONLY; not a 200 ka initial state, paleo parent material, or pedogenesis replay.
candidates.arcana_remap: Continuous fields area-weighted or conservative remap; categorical/quantile fields require explicit semantic handling; uncertainty bands must be retained.
semantic_ceiling: not independent validation where covariates overlap

additional_serious_candidates.reason: USGS describes near-global coarse-resolution surface geology; not a global unconsolidated parent-material or physical-profile authority.
Useful for broad geological context, but not demonstrated here as a globally harmonized, versioned surficial parent-material and vertical-profile authority.

circularity.soilgrids_dependency: SoilGrids is modeled from soil profiles and many environmental covariates including terrain/climate/land-cover information; overlapping ARCANA layers cannot be claimed as independent validation without qualification.
circularity.independent_provider_authority: GLiM and Pelletier are independent external datasets for their stated variables, but their combination does not create missing genetic/mineralogical provenance automatically.

composite_provider_analysis.later_gate: A composite initial-parent-state materialization gate could be scientifically feasible only after direct surficial-material/genetic provenance, temporal applicability, and vertical-profile contracts are recovered.

remaining_authority_gaps: 200 ka to 0 ka temporal adapter for surficial materials
governed vertical profile and layer identity
